title: Area Rugs Recalled Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard and Fire Hazard; Imported by Pacapet; Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com (Recall Alert)
summary: The rugs fail to meet the federal flammability standard for carpets and rugs, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 700.

summary: Cracks can form at the head tube area of the bicycle, where the fork connects to the bicycle. This can cause the frame to fail and allow the fork and front wheel to unexpectedly separate from the rest of the bicycle, posing a fall hazard to riders. title: Rugs Recalled Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard and Fire Hazard; Imported by Suellen Roosevein; Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com (Recall Alert)
summary: The rug fails to meet the federal flammability standard for carpets and rugs, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 100.

title: Tye Dye Area Rugs Recalled Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard and Fire Hazard; Imported by And Beyond; Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled rugs fail to meet the federal flammability standard for carpets and rugs, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 375.

title: dormakaba Recalls Delayed Egress Locks Due to Risk of Entrapment in an Emergency
summary: The lockset can fail to open, posing an entrapment hazard and inability to vacate a location in an emergency. Units: About 2,400.

title: LG Energy Solution Michigan Recalls Home Energy Storage Batteries Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The home batteries can overheat, posing a risk of fire and emission of harmful smoke. Units: About 10,000 (In addition, 2017-2019 RESU 10H were previously recalled for a fire hazard on December 16, 2020.).

title: Sling Loungers Sold at Dollar General Recalled Due to Amputation, Laceration, and Pinching Hazard; Manufactured by Shanghai Worth Garden Products
summary: The recalled loungers can collapse unexpectedly, posing an amputation, laceration and pinching hazard if finger gets caught in the metal folding joints. Units: About 155,000.

title: Two Million Dehumidifiers With Well-Known Brand Names Recalled Due to Fire and Burn Hazards; Manufactured by New Widetech
summary: The recalled dehumidifiers can overheat and catch fire, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 2 million (In addition, about 380,000 in Canada, and about 25,000 in Mexico).

title: Ryan and Rose Recalls Children's Eating Utensils Due to Choking Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The handle of the Cutie Spoovel utensil can break off releasing small parts, posing a choking hazard for young children. Units: About 17,750 (In addition, about 110 were sold in Canada).

title: Razor USA Recalls GLW Battery Packs Sold with Hovertrax 2.0 Self-Balancing Hoverboards Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The lithium-ion GLW battery packs in the self-balancing scooters/hoverboards can overheat, posing a risk of the products smoking, catching fire and/or exploding. Units: About 237,300.

title: Wee Gallery Recalls Wooden Tray Puzzles Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The octopus and elephant puzzle pieces can break, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 7,600 (In addition, about 550 in Canada).

title: Infant Bath Seats Recalled Due to Drowning Hazard; Imported by Frieyss and Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com (Recall Alert)
summary: The bath seats fail to meet the federal safety standard for infant bath seats, including requirements for stability and leg openings, and can tip over while in use, posing a drowning hazard to babies. Units: About 120.

title: John Deere Recalls Compact Utility Tractors Due to Risk of Injury (Recall Alert)
summary: Rear wheel spacer bolts that were torqued improperly during manufacturing can cause the wheel to fall off during use. This can result in the tractor overturning, posing an injury hazard to the operator. Units: About 200.

title: Hallmark Recalls Teethers Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The finished wooden ring can break into small parts, posing a choking hazard Units: About 15,500 (In addition, about 1,200 were sold in Canada).

title: Intertex Recalls Blower Fans Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The capacitor in the recalled VP-33 blower fans can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 29,500 (In addition, about 5,000 were sold in Canada).

title: Marin Mountain Bikes Recalls Bicycles Due to Fall and Crash Hazards
summary: The bottom bracket can break during use, causing the user to lose control, posing fall and crash hazards. Units: About 2,100 (In addition, 875 were sold in Canada).

title: Nordstrom Recalls Children's Socks Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The sock's pom pom can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 370.

title: Primark Recalls Scent Stamper Pens Due to Elevated Levels of Benzyl Alcohol; Risk of Skin Irritation
summary: The purple Scent Stamper Pen has elevated levels of benzyl alcohol, posing a risk of skin irritation. Units: About 9,500.

title: Ravin Crossbows Reannounces Recall of White Arrow Nocks Due to Injury Hazard and Additional Incidents; Nearly Two Dozen Serious Injuries Reported
summary: If the white nock is not fully engaged with the bowstring, the crossbow can fail to discharge when the trigger is pulled and can result in the bow discharging while re-nocking the arrow, posing an injury hazard to users. title: TJX Recalls Counter Stools Due to Fall and Injury Hazards; Sold at HomeGoods and Homesense Stores
summary: The counter stools can break or collapse, posing fall and injury hazards. Units: About 4,300.
